- CoinGecko ([coingecko.com](https://www.coingecko.com))  
- CoinMarketCap ([coinmarketcap.com](https://coinmarketcap.com))  
- Trading platforms like Binance, Coinbase, or Kraken  
- Financial news sites like Bloomberg or Reuters  

Also, keep in mind that Bitcoin’s price is highly volatile and can change rapidly across exchanges. Let me know if you’d like help understanding how Bitcoin pricing works, interpreting market trends, or evaluating key metrics (e.g., market cap, trading volume, or on-chain data).
